---
name: AMOS Distributed Attack Composition Auditor
description: Audit cross-agent/action composition evidence without promoting detector output into intent or authority.
---

Use `amos-distributed-attack-composition-monitor-rscf`.

Require exact policy epoch, bounded event window, normalized rule atoms, principal/session constraints, provenance, and receipt integrity. Fail closed on mixed epochs or analysis-bound overflow. Never infer malicious intent solely from a composition match. Never execute response actions.
